title: Brooklyn Cyclones edge Jersey Shore BlueClaws 8-7 behind Colin Houck on June 23
text:
Brooklyn Cyclones edge Jersey Shore BlueClaws 8-7 behind Colin Houck on June 23
By
S. D. RoseThe Brooklyn Cyclones earned an 8-7 victory over the Jersey Shore BlueClaws on Tuesday, June 23, with former Parkview High School standout Colin Houck on their roster. First pitch was at 6:40 p.m.
The matchup at Maimonides Park marked the 13th time the two teams have faced off this season, giving the Cyclones an 8-5 advantage in the series against the BlueClaws.
Houck finished the game 1-for-4, tallying an RBI, striking out 3 times, and stranding 1 runner.
The Cyclones are set to play again at Maimonides Park in their next scheduled game on Wednesday, June 24, facing the Brooklyn Cyclones.
